tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Priya.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Nadia.
You overhear it at the fire, and stop pretending not to listen. Riders from The Red Table are telling the deer story again — with your name attached this time.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Lucia.
🥣 Dmitri of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Dmitri waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
